The JUnit failures alone are not evidence of the selected coordination bug; trial 001, for example, reports the injected IPC response failure directly.

source_review: The original TestRenameWithSnapshots#testRenameUndo_1 starts MiniDFSCluster, creates two directories and a snapshot, then explicitly calls root.replaceChild(dir2, mockDir2, inodeMap). The selected second invocation has parent /dir1 and child foo: RenameOperation's constructor calls replaceChild4ReferenceWithName to prepare the snapshot source before the spy forces destination insertion to fail and rollback begins (FSDirRenameOp.java:672-680; INodeDirectory.java:381-398). Thus the selected check is during rename preparation, not the later rollback. Its old child should be the current child or nested reference target. Fault trials inject observed IPC response-read exceptions before this selected check; results are bounded to this path.
